summary: Xiao-I Corp, a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a Nasdaq notification of non-compliance with the minimum market value of publicly held shares (MVPHS) requirement. The notification was received on August 6, 2026, based on the closing bid price of its ADSs over 30 consecutive business days through August 4, 2026, showing MVPHS below the required $15 million. The company has a 180-day compliance period until February 1, 2027, to regain compliance. The notice has no immediate effect on listing or trading, and the company may appeal any delisting determination. The company intends to monitor its MVPHS and evaluate options, but there is no assurance of regaining compliance.
